head_commit.message:
fix(tui): clear stale shared prompt overlays

Remove externally resolved prompt overlays from the shared chat widget
without requiring the source thread to still be active. This keeps
background-thread approvals, user input requests, and MCP prompts from
remaining actionable after the server has already resolved them.

Walk the full bottom-pane modal stack when removing resolved requests so
buried overlays are cleaned up too. This prevents stale prompts from
reappearing after a higher-priority modal closes and locks the behavior
in with focused app and bottom-pane regressions.

head_commit.message:
fix(tui): preserve raw reasoning in restored snapshots

Carry `show_raw_agent_reasoning` through the app-server start/resume
state so snapshot replay keeps raw reasoning history when users enable
that transcript mode.

Update snapshot replay tests in the adapter and app restore path to pin
that resumed and forked threads retain the raw reasoning events instead
of dropping them during hydration.
